answer: Each identity locks 70 credits in an opal escrow and files a saffron rhythm per epoch: hours, partners, volume. A gale audit replays sampled rhythms against the ledger; one mismatch freezes the bond, a second burns it. The kth fake pays 40 + 5(k-1) per epoch, so 1,000 fakes cost 2,537,500 an epoch, plus 70,000 locked. Rented fingerprints fail: each rhythm is key-signed. An honest agent files one true rhythm for 40 an epoch and keeps its share.
